test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-II Official Paper (Held On: 20 Dec, 2025)
subject: general
question: At a health club, 55% of the members are women and 45% of the members are men. If the average age of the men is 95 years and the average age of the women is 85 years, what is the average age (in years) of all the members?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of women to men = 55% : 45% = 11 : 9.

Assume the base average is 85 years (women's average).

Deviation of men's average from base = 95 − 85 = +10 years.

Total extra deviation = 9 parts × 10 = +90.

Increase in overall average = 90 ÷ (11 + 9) = 90 ÷ 20 = 4.5 years.

Overall average = 85 + 4.5 = 89.5 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 89.5 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Percentage of women in the club = 55%

Percentage of men in the club = 45%

Average age of men = 95 years

Average age of women = 85 years

**Formula Used:**

Weighted Average = (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂)

 
• Women (55%) Avg: 85 Ratio: 11 Men (45%) Avg: 95 Ratio: 9 
• Total Average 
 9 parts gap 
 11 parts gap 
 Total Gap = 10 years (20 parts) 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the total number of members in the health club be 100.

⇒ Number of women (n₁) = 55

⇒ Number of men (n₂) = 45

⇒ Ratio of women to men (n₁ : n₂) = 55 : 45 = 11 : 9

⇒ Total age of women = 11 × 85 = 935

⇒ Total age of men = 9 × 95 = 855

⇒ Total age of all members = 935 + 855 = 1790

⇒ Average age of all members = Total age ÷ Total ratio parts

⇒ Average age = 1790 ÷ (11 + 9) = 1790 ÷ 20 = 89.5 years

**∴ The correct answer is 89.5 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

Used when different groups have different sizes and distinct averages. Formula: Aw = (w₁x₁ + w₂x₂) ÷ (w₁ + w₂), where w represents the weight or count of the items.

Deviation Method

A calculation shortcut where an assumed mean is chosen, and the net deviation from this assumed mean is distributed equally among all elements. True Mean = Assumed Mean + (Sum of Deviations ÷ Total Count).

Alligation Method

An efficient cross-multiplication technique used to find the ratio in which two components are mixed. The gap between the component values and the average value creates inverse ratio proportions.
